meta.name: clickhouse-managed-postgres-rca
meta.description: MUST USE when investigating performance issues on a ClickHouse-managed Postgres instance. Provides an evidence-based RCA workflow that scrapes the Prometheus endpoint for system signal, pulls per-digest evidence from the Slow Query Patterns API, and recommends (does not apply) a fix.

copy.tagline: 快速诊断Postgres实例的性能根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要排查Postgres慢查询的根本原因
copy.tagline_en: Quickly diagnose performance root causes for Postgres instances
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to find root causes of slow Postgres queries

howto.what: 当你报告 ClickHouse 托管的 Postgres 实例性能问题时，Claude 会按步骤抓取 Prometheus 指标和慢查询模式，分析根因并给出修复建议，但不会自动执行任何修改。
howto.when: 当你说明某个 ClickHouse 托管的 Postgres 实例出现慢查询、CPU 高、吞吐量低等问题时触发。

say.text: 我的 Postgres 实例很慢，帮我查一下原因。
say.note: Claude 会开始收集指标和慢查询。

say.text: 检查一下缓存命中率和慢查询模式。
say.note: Claude 会抓取 Prometheus 和慢查询数据。

say.text: 实例 CPU 高，看看是不是全表扫描。
say.note: Claude 会匹配全表扫描的启发式分析。

howto.what_en: When you report performance issues on a ClickHouse-managed Postgres instance, Claude follows a step-by-step workflow: scrapes Prometheus metrics, pulls slow query patterns, performs RCA, and recommends fixes (never applies them).
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user reports slowness, high CPU, low throughput, cache thrash, or similar issues on a ClickHouse-managed Postgres instance.

say_en.text: My Postgres instance is slow. Can you help analyze?
say_en.note: Claude will start collecting metrics and slow queries.

say_en.text: Check cache hit ratio and slow query patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will scrape Prometheus and fetch slow query data.

say_en.text: Instance CPU is high; see if there is a full scan.
say_en.note: Claude will match the full-scan heuristic.
